mapper.insert: /* Baim01Mapper.mergeMasterSiteAuthSet */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_SITE_AUTH ( CMPNY_CD , USER_CD , SITE_CD , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.USER_CD , #{siteCd} AS SITE_CD , 'Y' AS USE_YN , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} /* PRAFTA-042 H-2: 테넌트 격리 - 동일 회사 사용자로 한정 */ AND AUTH_CD IN ('master', 'hr', 'safe', 'system') /* PRAFTA-042-4: 전사 접근 역할 + 시스템 관리자 계정 */ ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = VALUES(UPDATE_DATE)

/* Baim01Mapper.mergeSiteAdminSiteAuth */
INSERT INTO TB_USER_SITE_AUTH ( CMPNY_CD , USER_CD , SITE_CD , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.USER_CD , #{siteCd} AS SITE_CD , 'Y' AS USE_YN , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} /* 테넌트 격리 - 동일 회사 사용자로 한정 */ AND A.USER_CD = #{siteAdminCd} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = VALUES(UPDATE_DATE)
mapper.select: /* Baim01Mapper.selectMirrorLockedFieldChangedCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SITE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD IS NOT NULL AND NOT ( IFNULL(A.SITE_NO, '') = IFNULL(#{siteNo}, '') AND IFNULL(A.SITE_NM, '') = IFNULL(#{siteNm}, '') AND IFNULL(A.ADDR_1, '') = IFNULL(#{addr1}, '') AND IFNULL(A.ADDR_2, '') = IFNULL(#{addr2}, '') AND IFNULL(A.ZIP_CODE, '') = IFNULL(#{zipCode}, '') AND IFNULL(A.STR_DATE, '') = IFNULL(REPLACE(#{strDate}, '-', ''), '') AND IFNULL(A.END_DATE, '') = IFNULL(REPLACE(#{endDate}, '-', ''), '') AND IFNULL(A.USE_YN, 'Y') = IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y') AND IFNULL(A.TEL_NO, '') = IFNULL(REPLACE(#{telNo}, '-', ''), '') AND IFNULL(A.GPS_RANGE, '0') = IFNULL(NULLIF(#{gpsRange}, ''), '0') AND IFNULL(A.SITE_DESC, '') = IFNULL(#{siteDesc}, '') )
